description: React component for viewing and managing user groups within a modal, including search, pagination, and group member display.

methods.name: incrementMemberCount
methods.description: Increments the member count state by 1.

methods.name: decrementMemberCount
methods.description: Decrements the member count state by 1.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input change and updates search term.

methods.name: getGroupMembers
methods.description: Fetches next page of group members with debounce.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll event to load more members when near bottom.

methods.name: mentionName
methods.description: Renders group mention name with source info.
